text:
elaine: Quick sync 1: we need a concise migration playbook for the v1 -> v2 host path and model alias swap. Ops want 2-week notice for redirects.

noah: thumbs-up. Can we include a one-page checklist that Docs, SDK, and Outreach can copy? I can draft the checklist items.

priya: priority items: update all example snippets (py/js/ts), fix any hard-coded `/v1/` URLs in guides, add a migration FAQ, and call out embed dimensionality changes for embedding model swaps.

elaine: agree. I'll add a compatibility matrix with columns: old path, new path, SDK surface change, embedding-dim delta, recommended fallback.

noah: for SDK changes, remember we removed the `ResponsesClientV1` wrapper in favor of the unified `ResponsesClient`. So snippets that import `ResponsesClientV1` will need replacement.

priya: propose a small lint job: CI step that runs grep -R "\/v1\/|ResponsesClientV1|embed-v1" across docs and sample apps and fails PRs. We should have a whitelist for archived content.

elaine: good idea. I'll add the lint job to docs CI and create a simple rule set in the repo.

dev-bot: created task list in docs issue #412: "v1 hostpath deprecation - docs sweep" and added assignees: @elaine @noah @priya

noah: timeline suggestion: week 0 publish migration guide and deprecation notice; week 1 SDK patch release with updated snippets; week 2 enable server-level redirects and start 301->302 header with deprecation info; week 6 remove legacy paths altogether (customer-facing warning window).

priya: we should add a short code example showing deprecation header to help integrators:

```
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
Location: https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
Deprecation: Thu, 01 Jun 2026 00:00:00 GMT
Link: <https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/v1-to-v2>; rel="documentation"
```

elaine: nice. Also include a sample SDK migration snippet for JS and Python in the guide. Keep them minimal.

noah: I'll grep the community templates and sandbox apps for broken references and open fix PRs. tagging @dev-rel for potential customer outreach copy.

priya: add a line in the migration guide about index rebuilds for embeddings: if dims change, advise "re-embed your corpus or provide dimensionality transformer" and link to the embeddings best-practices doc.

elaine: handle links: we should add redirects in the docs site config for any removed pages to preserve SEO. I'll prepare the redirect map file and include it in the PR.

dev-bot: linked PR #1439 and checklist to issue #412, added label "deprecation-docs"

noah: last ask: can we get a short notice snippet for the #announcements post? 2 lines + link to migration guide. I can draft.

priya: going to run a quick smoke search for `/v1/` in markdown and code fences and post a blurb in the PR with files that must not be changed (archived posts).

elaine: perfect. Once PR is ready please ping here. We'll coordinate with SDK leads to stagger releases so customers have a clear path. :rocket:
